featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently purchased jewellery from Bluestone, and I couldn’t be happier with the entire experience. From the moment I walked in, the staff made me feel comfortable and welcomed. Namrata was the staff helping is and she took her time to understand what I was looking for and patiently guided me through different designs.

What impressed me the most was the detailed explanation for every jewellery piece—from the metal purity and gemstone quality to the craftsmanship and design inspiration. Their product knowledge is outstanding, and I felt completely informed and confident in my choices.

Namrata also briefed me on their ongoing offers and subscription plans, which I found extremely helpful. The team clearly explained how the gold-saving plan works and how I could benefit from future discounts and pre-booking designs. It didn’t feel pushy at all—just genuine guidance aimed at helping customers make smart decisions.

Overall, Bluestone delivered a smooth, transparent, and customer-friendly experience. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for beautifully designed jewellery and exceptional service.

featured_reviews.name: Viresh Shinde
featured_reviews.review_text:
Dear Manager,

I am writing to express my disappointment with the recent customer service experience at your establishment. A few months ago, we purchased a gold chain from your store, which unfortunately broke. Instead of opting for a repair, we decided to exchange it for a new one.

As long-standing customers, we requested a reasonable accommodation—to pay half of the difference for the 14K gold (including GST) upfront, with the remaining amount to be settled by evening. This was due to a temporary cash shortage and the fact that our elderly parents, who were handling the transaction, are not well-versed with digital payment methods like GPay. Despite surrendering the old chain and assuring full payment by the end of the day, the executive on duty was uncooperative and insensitive to our situation.

It was disheartening to see a lack of empathy, especially toward senior citizens who had to make an additional trip due to this inflexibility. As a reputed jeweler, I expect your team to handle such situations with professionalism and courtesy, keeping in mind that customers may face genuine constraints.

Is this how you treat long-term customers? Earning commission doesn’t justify disrespect. Your staff should learn to be polite, humble, and understanding—especially toward seniors. If this is your standard of service, then BIG NO NEXT TIME.

I urge you to remind your staff to treat customers—especially elderly ones—with patience and understanding. A little compassion can go a long way in retaining trust and loyalty.
